auditProvenance.selfReferentialCommitRule: A Git commit cannot contain its own final commit SHA inside tracked files. sourceCommitSha records the verified HEAD commit present when the generator ran, workingTreeState and snapshotBasis record whether uncommitted working-tree changes were present on top of sourceCommitSha, and auditedInputsSha256 digests the exact audited file contents.
